title: DAY 4 — LESSON 2: MANAGING ANGER, FRUSTRATION AND DISAPPOINTMENT

options: A sign that someone is unprofessional
An emotional response that may arise when someone feels threatened, disrespected or treated unfairly

questions.prompt: What should an employee do when becoming frustrated?
options: Pause, identify the issue and choose a constructive response

questions.prompt: An employee is disappointed because a colleague receives recognition. What is the best response?
options: Acknowledge the disappointment and seek feedback for improvement

questions.prompt: What does the STOP method encourage?
options: Stopping, taking a moment, observing and proceeding professionally

questions.prompt: Does managing anger mean employees must remain silent about unfair treatment?
options: No. Genuine concerns can be communicated respectfully through appropriate channels
Yes. Employees must accept every situation without question
Yes. Expressing disappointment is always unprofessional
